Application Data.NAME: Artful Interiors, LLC
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Artful Interiors, LLC specializes in providing comprehensive interior decorating and design services, focusing on residential and commercial spaces. Our operations encompass space planning, color consultation, furniture selection, and the creation of custom design concepts tailored to meet clients' individual tastes and needs. We maintain a strong commitment to safety and environmental responsibility, ensuring that all materials sourced comply with industry standards and regulations. As part of our design services, we avoid the use of non-native or invasive plant species to mitigate environmental risks. Additionally, we oversee any subcontractors involved in our projects, ensuring their compliance with safety protocols and operational standards.
